GEO600 in 2011: Joint GEO600 Virgo run

In the summer of 2011, GEO600 joined the Virgo detector in a 3-month long observing run. At high frequencies (≥2 kHz), the GEO detector reached the same (or a slightly better) sensitivity as the 5 times larger Virgo detector.

Science-quality data were acquired for about 79 days, with squeezing applied for about half of the time.
